items.t: Oil sludge and loss of oil pressure
items.job: Remove oil pan, clean or replace pickup screen, flush and refill oil
items.note: If the bearings are already damaged, an engine replacement runs $4,000–$6,000 or more, which is what many owners reported paying.

items.t: Dropped valve seat causing misfire and lost power
items.job: Replace or rebuild one cylinder head with new gaskets
items.note: Reported total cost is $1,000 and up. If debris damaged a piston, the engine may need replacing.

items.t: Overheating and head gasket failure
items.job: Replace head gaskets (one or both sides)
items.note: Reported cost is roughly $600–$1,000 per the source, more at dealer rates or if heads need machining.

items.t: Intake plenum gasket leak burns oil
items.job: Replace intake plenum pan gasket with upgraded plate kit
items.note: An aftermarket kit with a thicker plate is about $195. Replace fouled plugs at the same time.

items.t: Camshaft position sensor failure
items.job: Replace camshaft position sensor

items.t: Broken exhaust manifold bolts cause ticking
items.job: Extract broken manifold bolts and replace bolts and gasket
items.note: Time depends on how many bolts are broken and whether they can be drilled out in the truck.

items.t: Stalling while driving from crank sensor fault
items.job: Replace crankshaft position sensor

items.t: Radiator leaks and overheating
items.job: Replace radiator and refill coolant

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report about $2,600–$3,000 total.

items.t: Upper ball joint wear and separation (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Dodge/Ram dealer
items.note: Free under recall 04V-596 for 2000–2003 4x4 trucks. Check your VIN.

items.t: Lower ball joints, tie rods and sway bar links wear
items.job: Replace front lower ball joints and align
items.note: Tie rod ends or sway bar links add about $100–$300 each.

items.t: Front wheel bearing or hub failure
items.job: Replace front wheel bearing/hub assembly (one side)

items.t: Front brake locks up and wheel overheats
items.job: Replace front caliper, brake hose, pads and rotors
items.note: Owners report a typical bill of around $400–$500.

items.t: Steering wheel shake when braking from warped rotors
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
items.note: Add $50–$120 per caliper if one is sticking.

items.t: Clicking behind dash and wrong air temperature
items.job: Replace HVAC blend door actuator

items.t: Power window regulator breaks
items.job: Replace power window regulator (one door)

items.t: Paint peeling off
items.job: Repaint affected panels
items.note: Owners report about $2,200 for larger repaint jobs.

items.t: Rust on radiator support and body panels
items.job: Repair or replace rusted radiator support section
items.note: Rough estimate; body shop prices vary widely with how far the rust has spread.

items.t: Takata airbag inflators can rupture (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Dodge/Ram dealer
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or with a dealer.

items.t: Rear axle pinion nut can loosen and lock the axle (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Dodge/Ram dealer
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or with a dealer.

items.t: Clockspring can disable driver airbag (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Dodge/Ram dealer
items.note: Free under recall 01V-153. Outside the recall, a clockspring costs roughly $100–$250 in parts.

items.t: Brake tube or hose can be rubbed through (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Dodge/Ram dealer
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or with a dealer.

items.t: Transmission fluid can leak onto exhaust (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Dodge/Ram dealer
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or with a dealer.

items.t: Wiper, lighting and wiring faults (recalls)
items.job: Recall repair at a Dodge/Ram dealer
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or with a dealer.

items.t: Truck may roll away in Park (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Dodge/Ram dealer
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or with a dealer.

items.t: Manual-transmission truck may not start or may lurch (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Dodge/Ram dealer
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or with a dealer.

items.t: Computer faults can lock wheels or affect ABS (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Dodge/Ram dealer
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or with a dealer.
